sql: SELECT table_name,ordinal_position,column_name,column_type,is_nullable,column_default,column_comment,column_key FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name IN ('td_products','td_products_attrs','td_products_extend','td_products_extra','td_products_images','td_products_sku','td_products_supplier','td_products_collection','td_products_cost','td_product_fabric_spu','td_fitting','td_fitting_sku','td_fitting_images','td_pcs_site','td_pcs_shelves','td_pcs_shelves_sku','td_tcategory','td_tcategory_shopee','td_tcategory_tiktok_v2','td_fcs_pantone_color_map','td_pcs_pattern_library','td_fcs_process','td_fcs_process_station') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

SELECT table_name,ordinal_position,column_name,column_type,is_nullable,column_default,column_comment,column_key FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name IN ('td_products','td_products_sku','td_products_extra','td_products_cost','td_products_collection','td_dm1','td_dm2','td_attr','td_attr_value','td_attr_plate','td_tcategory','td_tcategory_shopee') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

SELECT table_name,ordinal_position,column_name,column_type,is_nullable,column_default,column_comment,column_key FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name IN ('td_spu_print_dye_price') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position
SELECT d.id,d.name,d.type,COUNT(v.id) value_count FROM td_dm1 d LEFT JOIN td_dm2 v ON v.dm1=d.id GROUP BY d.id,d.name,d.type ORDER BY d.id
SELECT id,name,type,LEFT(plate_attrs,500) plate_attrs_sample FROM td_attr ORDER BY id LIMIT 60
SELECT id,attr_name,attr_type,attr_plate_id,attr_mode_type FROM td_attr_plate ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
SELECT dm1,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT name) distinct_names FROM td_attr_value GROUP BY dm1 ORDER BY dm1
SELECT id,pantone_no,color_no,color_no_segment,status FROM td_fcs_pantone_color_map WHERE is_delete=0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 12
SELECT id,code,name,process_station_id,apply_targets,generate_task,standard_price,currency,cost_unit FROM td_fcs_process WHERE is_delete=0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 30
SELECT id,dm1,name,code,id_code,brand_id FROM td_dm2 WHERE dm1 IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,13,14,15,16,24,106,107,108,109,110) ORDER BY dm1,id LIMIT 5000
SELECT id,dm1,name,code,LEFT(plate_values,700) plate_values_sample FROM td_attr_value WHERE dm1 IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,106) ORDER BY dm1,id LIMIT 600

SELECT table_name,column_name,column_type,column_comment FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND column_name IN ('purchase_price','purchase_price_currency','transport_cost','transport_cost_currency','comprehensive_fabric_cost','fabric_material_type') ORDER BY table_name,column_name LIMIT 200

SELECT table_name,column_name,column_type,column_comment FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND column_name IN ('purchase_price','purchase_price_currency','transport_cost','transport_cost_currency','comprehensive_fabric_cost','fabric_material_type') ORDER BY table_name,column_name LIMIT 200

SELECT TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,SEQ_IN_INDEX,COLUMN_NAME,SUB_PART FROM information_schema.statistics WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('td_fcs_pantone_color_map','td_fcs_process','td_fcs_process_station','td_fitting','td_fitting_images','td_fitting_sku','td_pcs_pattern_library','td_pcs_shelves','td_pcs_shelves_sku','td_pcs_site','td_product_fabric_spu','td_products','td_products_attrs','td_products_collection','td_products_cost','td_products_extend','td_products_extra','td_products_images','td_products_sku','td_products_supplier','td_tcategory','td_tcategory_shopee','td_tcategory_tiktok_v2','td_spu_print_dye_price') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX

SELECT TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.key_column_usage WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('td_fcs_pantone_color_map','td_fcs_process','td_fcs_process_station','td_fitting','td_fitting_images','td_fitting_sku','td_pcs_pattern_library','td_pcs_shelves','td_pcs_shelves_sku','td_pcs_site','td_product_fabric_spu','td_products','td_products_attrs','td_products_collection','td_products_cost','td_products_extend','td_products_extra','td_products_images','td_products_sku','td_products_supplier','td_tcategory','td_tcategory_shopee','td_tcategory_tiktok_v2','td_spu_print_dye_price') AND REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE,TRIGGER_NAME,EVENT_MANIPULATION,ACTION_TIMING FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE IN ('td_fcs_pantone_color_map','td_fcs_process','td_fcs_process_station','td_fitting','td_fitting_images','td_fitting_sku','td_pcs_pattern_library','td_pcs_shelves','td_pcs_shelves_sku','td_pcs_site','td_product_fabric_spu','td_products','td_products_attrs','td_products_collection','td_products_cost','td_products_extend','td_products_extra','td_products_images','td_products_sku','td_products_supplier','td_tcategory','td_tcategory_shopee','td_tcategory_tiktok_v2','td_spu_print_dye_price') ORDER BY EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE,TRIGGER_NAME
SELECT product_type,stock_type,is_yarn,status,audit_status,COUNT(*) n FROM td_fitting GROUP BY product_type,stock_type,is_yarn,status,audit_status ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT primary_sku,COUNT(*) n FROM td_fitting GROUP BY primary_sku HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) n,SUM(primary_sku IS NULL OR primary_sku='') blank_code,SUM(fabric_composition IS NULL OR fabric_composition='') blank_composition,SUM(cost_price=0) zero_cost FROM td_fitting
SELECT tag,COUNT(*) n,SUM(supplier_id IS NULL OR supplier_id=0) missing_supplier_id FROM td_products_supplier GROUP BY tag LIMIT 20

SELECT TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,SEQ_IN_INDEX,COLUMN_NAME,SUB_PART FROM information_schema.statistics WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('td_attr','td_attr_plate','td_attr_value','td_dm1','td_dm2','td_products','td_products_collection','td_products_cost','td_products_extra','td_products_sku','td_tcategory','td_tcategory_shopee') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX

SELECT TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.key_column_usage WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('td_attr','td_attr_plate','td_attr_value','td_dm1','td_dm2','td_products','td_products_collection','td_products_cost','td_products_extra','td_products_sku','td_tcategory','td_tcategory_shopee') AND REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE,TRIGGER_NAME,EVENT_MANIPULATION,ACTION_TIMING FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE IN ('td_attr','td_attr_plate','td_attr_value','td_dm1','td_dm2','td_products','td_products_collection','td_products_cost','td_products_extra','td_products_sku','td_tcategory','td_tcategory_shopee') ORDER BY EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE,TRIGGER_NAME
SELECT product_type,status,audit_status,stock_type,is_yarn,COUNT(*) n FROM td_products GROUP BY product_type,status,audit_status,stock_type,is_yarn ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 150
SELECT freight,COUNT(*) n FROM td_products GROUP BY freight ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT status,is_delete,price_type,COUNT(*) n FROM td_products_sku GROUP BY status,is_delete,price_type ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 80
SELECT COUNT(*) n,SUM(primary_sku IS NULL OR primary_sku='') blank_code,SUM(vendor IS NULL OR vendor='') blank_vendor,SUM(supplier_id IS NULL OR supplier_id=0) missing_supplier_id FROM td_products
SELECT primary_sku,COUNT(*) n FROM td_products WHERE primary_sku IS NOT NULL AND primary_sku<>'' GROUP BY primary_sku HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT sku,COUNT(*) n FROM td_products_sku WHERE sku IS NOT NULL AND sku<>'' GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT p.id,p.primary_sku,p.product_type,p.status,p.audit_status FROM td_products p WHERE p.primary_sku IN ('YSSZAW122101','FADAH25033110','ALHH081104') ORDER BY p.primary_sku,p.id LIMIT 30

SELECT s.id,s.p_id,s.sku,s.status,s.is_delete,p.status parent_status,p.primary_sku FROM td_products_sku s LEFT JOIN td_products p ON p.id=s.p_id WHERE s.sku IN ('FADAH25033110-sameasphoto-m','BTSZIDOE050704') ORDER BY s.sku,s.id LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM td_products_sku s LEFT JOIN td_products p ON p.id=s.p_id WHERE p.id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM td_products_sku s JOIN td_products p ON p.id=s.p_id WHERE s.spu IS NOT NULL AND s.spu<>'' AND s.spu<>p.primary_sku

SELECT product_type,stock_type,cost_price_method,COUNT(*) n FROM td_products WHERE product_type IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY product_type,stock_type,cost_price_method ORDER BY product_type,stock_type,n DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT price_type,side_type,COUNT(*) n FROM td_products_sku WHERE price_type<>0 GROUP BY price_type,side_type ORDER BY price_type,side_type LIMIT 50
